source_binding.rule: Use current fixed source bytes at audit start; do not substitute historical HEAD or old output snapshots.

method: Static path/index/rg entrypoint mapping only; no Godot, native run, build, APK, device, or generated-data rewrite.
exclude_roots: docs/review/ historical evidence and archived candidates/
credentials, keys, local user data, generated caches and binary-only source material

audit_edges: 300ms rich planning versus immediate attack lane
cold wake and stale target retirement
no hand edits to generated outputs

consumers: outputs only as evidence input, excluded from scope authority

entrypoints: data catalogs and runtime policy JSON

audit_edges: status must remain NOT_RUN until reviewed

coverage_rules: Every production entrypoint must map to its direct consumers and at least one contract or explicit NOT_RUN gap.
Generated files are audited for provenance and consumers; fixes belong in authoring/build sources, never by hand-editing generated output.
Binary assets are checked through manifests/hashes/consumer references, not byte-by-byte semantic review in this static manifest.
Historical outputs and reports may provide evidence pointers only; they cannot establish current-source PASS.
Final claims require root source binding, exact engine/input fingerprints, and separate static/native/device status.

source_binding_policy.dirty_source_allowlist: Root must bind final fixed 61d source plus explicitly approved current production overlay; current git presence is recorded per path and is not itself a fixed-source claim.
source_binding_policy.generated_rule: Audit generated/runtime files for provenance and consumers; corrections belong in authoring source.

inventory_policy.enumeration: Current filesystem under explicit include roots, filtered to reviewable text extensions; each path is assigned to a module, including residual_review where classification remains open.
inventory_policy.git_presence: tracked_clean_observed_head, tracked_dirty, and working_tree_only are observed against current HEAD/status; none is a claim that the path belongs to fixed 61d until root binds that SHA.
inventory_policy.excluded_binary_or_generated_sidecar: Binary-only art/raw-import/material and .import sidecars are excluded from file-level text review but remain boundary entries; generated text is included and must trace to authoring source.
inventory_policy.excluded_tool_payloads: tools/android-build, tools/godot-4.7, tools/vendor and tool caches/download payloads are excluded as third-party/SDK/cache material.
